fragments.text: יִשְׁתַּבַּח שִׁמְךָ לָעַד מַלְכֵּנוּ הָאֵל הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ. כִּי לְךָ נָאֶה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ שִׁיר וּשְׁבָחָה הַלֵּל וְזִמְרָה עֹז וּמֶמְשָׁלָה נֶצַח גְּדֻלָּה וּגְבוּרָה תְּהִלָּה וְתִפְאֶרֶת קְדֻשָּׁה וּמַלְכוּת בְּרָכוֹת וְהוֹדָאוֹת מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֵל מֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל בַּתִּשְׁבָּחוֹת אֵל הַהוֹדָאוֹת אֲדוֹן הַנִּפְלָאוֹת הַבּוֹחֵר בְּשִׁירֵי זִמְרָה מֶלֶךְ אֵל חֵי הָעוֹלָמִים:

May Thy Name be praised for ever, O our King, God the great and holy King in heaven and on earth. For Thine, O Lord our God and God of our fathers, are song and glory, praise and music, might and dominion, victory, greatness and strength, fame and splendour, blessings and thanks from now until eternity. Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, King famed in eulogies, God of thanksgiving, Master of wonders, who chooses songs of praise, O King, everlasting God.
וְעַתָּה יִגְדַּל־נָא כֹּחַ אֲדֹנָי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ לֵאמֹר:
And now let the power of the Lord appear great, as Thou hast said:

fragments.text: זְכֹר רַחֲמֶיךָ יְיָ וַחֲסָדֶיךָ כִּי מֵעוֹלָם הֵמָּה:
Remember Thy mercy, O Lord, and Thy kindnesses for they have always existed.

יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא בְּעָלְמָא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל־בֵּית־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב. וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.
יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא.

יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְּקֻדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא לְעֵלָּא וּלְעֵלָּא מִכָּל־בִּרְכָתָא וְשִׁירָתָא תֻּשְׁבְּחָתָא וְנֶחֱמָתָא דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְמָא. וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:

Exalted and sanctified be His Great Name in the world which He has created according to His will. May His Kingdom be established in your lifetime and in your days and in the lifetime of the whole House of Israel, speedily and in a short time, and say: Amen!
May His Great Name be praised to eternity and the eternity of eternities.

Blessed and praised and glorified and elevated and exalted and adorned and raised on high and lauded be the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He; high, yea high, above all blessing and song, praise and comfort that has ever been spoken in the world, and say Amen.
בָּרְכוּ אֶת־יְיָ הַמְבֹרָךְ:
בָּרוּךְ יְיָ הַמְבֹרָךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:

יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא שְׁמוֹ שֶׁל מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא שֶׁהוּא רִאשׁוֹן וְהוּא אַחֲרוֹן וּמִבַּלְעָדָיו אֵין אֱלֹהִים סֹלּוּ לָרֹכֵב בָּעֲרָבוֹת בְּיָהּ שְׁמוֹ וְעִלְזוּ לְפָנָיו. וּשְׁמוֹ מְרוֹמָם עַל כָּל בְּרָכָה וּתְהִלָּה:
בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
יְהִי שֵׁם יְיָ מְבֹרָךְ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם:
Bless the Lord who is called blessed.
Blessed is the Lord who is called blessed, for ever and ever.

Blessed and praised, glorified, exalted and extolled be the Name of the Supreme King of Kings, the Holy One, blessed be He. He is the first and He is the last and beside Him there is no God. Make way before Him, who is enthroned above the clouds, Yah is His Name, and rejoice before Him, His Name is exalted above all blessing and fame.
Blessed be Him, His Name is exalted above and ever.
Let the Lord’s Name be blessed from now until eternity.
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם יוֹצֵר אוֹר וּבוֹרֵא חֹשֶׁךְ עֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם וּבוֹרֵא אֶת־הַכֹּל:
Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God, King of the World, who forms light and creates darkness, establishes peace and creates everything.
אוֹר עוֹלָם בְּאוֹצַר חַיִּים אוֹרוֹת מֵאֹפֶל אָמַר וַיֶּהִי:
Light of the world in the treasury of life, lights from the darkness did He call forth and it came to pass.
מֶלֶךְ אָזוּר גְּבוּרָה. גָּדוֹל שִׁמְךָ בִּגְבוּרָה. לְךָ זְרוֹעַ עִם גְּבוּרָה:
מֶלֶךְ בִּגְדֵי נָקָם. לָבֵשׁ בְּיוֹם נָקָם. לְצָרָיו יָשִׁיב אֶל־חֵיקָם:
מֶלֶךְ גֵּאוּת לָבֵשׁ. יַמִּים מְיַבֵּשׁ. וְגַאֲוַת אֲפִיקִים מְכַבֵּשׁ:
מֶלֶךְ בַּעֲשָׂרָה לְבוּשִׁים. הִתְאַזַּר בַּקְּדוֹשִׁים. אֵל נַעֲרָץ בְּסוֹד קְדוֹשִׁים. קָדוֹשׁ:
מֶלֶךְ דָּר בִּנְהוֹרָא. עוֹטֶה כַשַּׂלְמָה אוֹרָה. מִשְׁפָּטֵנוּ יוֹצִיא כָאוֹרָה:
מֶלֶךְ הִתְאַזַּר עֹז. יְמִינוֹ תָּעוֹז. וֶאֱנוֹשׁ אַל יָעוֹז:
מֶלֶךְ וַיִּלְבַּשׁ צְדָקָה. וְנִקְדַּשׁ בִּצְדָקָה. לְךָ יְיָ הַצְּדָקָה:
מֶלֶךְ זֶה הָדוּר בִּלְבוּשׁוֹ. וְכוֹבַע יְשׁוּעָה בְּרֹאשׁוֹ. אֱלֹהִים יָשַׁב עַל כִּסֵּא קָדְשׁוֹ:
מֶלֶךְ חֲמוּץ בְּגָדִים. בְּדָרְכוֹ בוֹגְדִים. יִבְצֹר רוּחַ נְגִידִים:
מֶלֶךְ טַלִּיתוֹ כַשֶּׁלֶג מְצֻחְצָח. צַח וּבְצַחְצָחוֹת יְצַחְצַח. מְצַחְצְחִים פָּעֳלָם לָנֶצַח:
מֶלֶךְ יַעַט קִנְאָה. קַנֹּא קִנֵּא גָּאֹה גָאָה. כְּאִישׁ מִלְחָמוֹת יָעִיר קִנְאָה:
מֶלֶךְ, כָּל־אַפְסֵי אָרֶץ. יִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל־הָאָרֶץ. כִּי בָא לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת־הָאָרֶץ:
מֶלֶךְ לְיוֹם קוּמוֹ לָעַד. כָּל־יְצוּר לְפָנָיו יִרְעַד. רָם וְנִשָּׂא שׁוֹכֵן עַד:
מֶלֶךְ
מוֹשֵׁל עוֹלָם בִּגְבוּרָתוֹ. יִרְעֲשׁוּ הָרִים מִגַּאֲוָתוֹ. וּכְאֵילִים יִרְקְדוּ מִגַּעֲרָתוֹ:
מֶלֶךְ נוֹרָא לְמַלְכֵי אָרֶץ. חוֹל תָּחוּל הָאָרֶץ. מִיּוֹשֵׁב הַכְּרוּבִים תָּנוּט הָאָרֶץ:
מֶלֶךְ שְׂאֵתוֹ מִי יַעֲצָר־כֹּחַ. וְהוּא נוֹשֵׂא כֹל בַּכֹּחַ. נוֹתֵן לַיָּעֵף כֹּחַ:
מֶלֶךְ עָמְדוֹ לָדִין. בְּיוֹם הַדִּין. שְׁפוֹט גֵּאִים בַּדִּין:
מֶלֶךְ פִּלֵּשׂ סוֹד הַמַּעֲמִיקִים. לַסְתִּיר עֵצָה בְּמַעֲמַקִּים. יֶחֱשֹׂף וִיגַלֶּה עֲמוּקִים:
מֶלֶךְ צִוָּה מִכָּל־רוּחַ. עָרִיצֵי גַּסֵּי הָרוּחַ. לְאַפְּפָם בְּשֶׁטֶף רוּחַ:
מֶלֶךְ קְהֵל מַלְכֵי אֲדָמָה. בְּסַעֲרוֹ מַשָּׂא דוּמָה. יִפְקֹד עַל צְבָא רוּמָה:
מֶלֶךְ רָם וְגָבֹהַּ בְּמִשְׁפָּט. וְעֹז מֶלֶךְ אֹהֵב מִשְׁפָּט. מְכוֹן כִּסְאוֹ צֶדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט:
מֶלֶךְ שׁוֹפֵט צֶדֶק. לְפָנָיו יְהַלֵּךְ צֶדֶק. לְהָלִיץ בְּעַד רוֹדְפֵי צֶדֶק:
מֶלֶךְ תַּקִּיף בְּמֶמְשָׁלָה. וְכִסְאוֹ תָּלָה לְמָעְלָה. וּמַלְכוּתוֹ בַּכֹּל מָשָׁלָה:
מֶלֶךְ תִחֵת חֶלֶד מֵהַבִּיטוֹ. מַרְעִיד יְסוֹד בְּהַבִּיטוֹ. בַּכֹּל מְשׁוֹטֵט מַבָּטוֹ:
מֶלֶךְ תָּר בְּכָל־פֹּעַל. בַּכֹּל מָה יִפְעַל. בְּמַטָּה וּבְמַעַל:
מֶלֶךְ אֱלֹהֵי עוֹלָם. הִמְלִיכוּהוּ עַם עוֹלָם. יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם. קָדוֹשׁ:
O King girded with might, great is Thy Name in might, Thine is an arm with might.
The King is clothed in vestments of vengeance on the day of vengeance, He requites His enemies to their bosom.
The King is clothed in majesty, He dries the seas and subdues the pride of rivers.
The King with ten vestments has girded Himself among holy ones, God who is adored in the council of the holy, is holy.
The King who dwells in light, who wears light like a robe, will issue our verdict as if it were light.
The King has girded Himself with strength, His right hand shows strength while man has no strength.
The King is clothed in righteousness and sanctified through righteousness. Thine, O Lord, is righteousness.
This King splendid in His clothing with a helmet of salvation upon His head, God is seated on His holy throne.
The King whose vestments are crimson when He treads down renegades and lowers the spirit of princes.
The King whose cloak is like purified snow, is pure and in purity purifies those who purify their work to triumph.
The King is draped in zeal, He is enflamed with zeal, He carries Himself high, like a warrior does He arouse zeal.
The King — all the ends of the earth bow down to the King over all the earth when He comes to judge the earth.
The King, on the day when He rises for ever, every creature will tremble before Him, lofty and exalted and eternal.
The
King, who rules the world in His might, mountains quake before His majesty and jump like rams before His rebuke.
The King, awe-inspiring to the kings of the earth, the earth is surely quaking before Him who dwells above the Cherubim, the earth trembles.
The King, who has the strength to bear Him? For He bears all with strength and to the weary does He grant strength.
The King, when He rises to give judgment on the day of judgment, to judge the proud in judgment.
The King searches out the secret of those who go deep to conceal a plan in the depths, and He reveals and exposes the things that are deep.
O King, command that the haughty tyrants should be hemmed in from every side by the fury of the tempest.
The King assembles the kings of the earth when He fulfils in the storm the prophesy of Duma, then will He reckon with the host of the summit.
The King, high and exalted in judgment, the might of the King loves judgment, the foundation of His throne is justice and judgment.
The King is the just Judge, justice walks before Him, to plead for those who strive for justice.
The King mighty in dominion, His throne is suspended above, His realm prevails over all.
The King makes the earth quake with His glance, He shakes the foundations with His glance, over all there roams His glance.
The King searches every creature, and all that he may do both below and above.
The King is God of eternity, the eternal people has crowned Him. The Lord rules unto eternity, the Holy One.

he.text: ע״ס א״ב אחרי תבת מלך בראש החרוזים, ובחלק השני מד׳ חרוזים הראשונים חתום שם המחבר גדליה.

fragments.text: הַמֵּאִיר לָאָרֶץ וְלַדָּרִים עָלֶיהָ בְּרַחֲמִים. וּבְטוּבוֹ מְחַדֵּשׁ בְּכָל־יוֹם תָּמִיד מַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית:
מָה רַבּוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ יְיָ כֻּלָּם בְּחָכְמָה עָשִׂיתָ. מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ קִנְיָנֶךָ:
הַמֶּלֶךְ הַמְרוֹמָם לְבַדּוֹ מֵאָז. הַמְשֻׁבָּח וְהַמְפֹאָר וְהַמִּתְנַשֵּׂא מִימוֹת עוֹלָם: אֱלֹהֵי עוֹלָם בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ.
אֲדוֹן
עֻזֵּנוּ צוּר מִשְׂגַּבֵּנוּ. מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵנוּ מִשְׂגָּב בַּעֲדֵנוּ:
He who lights the earth and those who dwell on it, with mercy and daily in His goodness constantly renews the work of creation.
How numerous are Thy works, O Lord, all of them hast Thou made with wisdom, the earth is full of Thy possessions.
O King, who alone is exalted from of old, extolled and praised and glorified since days of antiquity. O God of eternity, in Thy great mercy have mercy upon us,
Lord of our might, Rock of our fortress, shield of our salvation, a fortress around us.

הַכֹּל יוֹדוּךָ וְהַכֹּל יְשַׁבְּחוּךָ. וְהַכֹּל יֹאמְרוּ אֵין קָדוֹשׁ כַּייָ הַכֹּל יְרוֹמְמוּךָ סֶּלָה יוֹצֵר הַכֹּל. הָאֵל הַפּוֹתֵחַ בְּכָל־יוֹם דַּלְתוֹת שַׁעֲרֵי מִזְרָח. וּבוֹקֵעַ חַלּוֹנֵי רָקִיעַ. מוֹצִיא חַמָּה מִמְּקוֹמָהּ וּלְבָנָה מִמְּכוֹן שִׁבְתָּהּ: וּמֵאִיר לָעוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ וּלְיוֹשְׁבָיו. שֶׁבָּרָא בְּמִדַּת רַחֲמִים: הַמֵּאִיר לָאָרֶץ וְלַדָּרִים עָלֶיהָ בְּרַחֲמִים. וּבְטוּבוֹ מְחַדֵּשׁ בְּכָל יוֹם תָּמִיד מַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית: הַמֶּלֶךְ הַמְרוֹמָם לְבַדּוֹ מֵאָז. הַמְשֻׁבָּח וְהַמְפֹאָר וְהַמִּתְנַשֵּׂא מִימוֹת עוֹלָם: אֱלֹהֵי עוֹלָם בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ. אֲדוֹן עֻזֵּנוּ צוּר מִשְׂגַּבֵּנוּ. מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵנוּ מִשְׂגָּב בַּעֲדֵנוּ: אֵין כְּעֶרְכֶּךָ וְאֵין זוּלָתֶךָ. אֶפֶס בִּלְתֶּךָ וּמִי דוֹמֶה־לָּךְ: אֵין כְּעֶרְכֶּךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה. וְאֵין זוּלָתְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ לְחַיֵּי הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא: אֶפֶס בִּלְתְּךָ גּוֹאֲלֵנוּ לִימוֹת הַמָּשִׁיחַ. וְאֵין דּוֹמֶה לְךָ מוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ לִתְחִיַּת הַמֵּתִים:

All thank Thee, all praise Thee, all say: None is holy like the Lord. All exalt Thee, Selah, Creator of all, God who opens daily the portals of the Eastern gates and throws open windows of the firmament, brings forth the sun from its place and the moon from the site of its dwelling. He illuminates the whole world and its inhabitants whom He created through the attribute of mercy. He illuminates the earth and those who dwell on it with mercy, and in His goodness renews daily and constantly the work of creation. O King, who alone is exalted from of old, extolled and praised and glorified since days of antiquity. O God of eternity, in Thy great mercy have mercy upon us, Lord of our might, Rock of our fortress, shield of our salvation, a fortress around us. None can be compared with Thee, there is none except Thee, none beside Thee and who resembles Thee? None can be compared with Thee, O Lord our God, in this world and there is none except Thee, our King, in the life of the future world. There will be nought besides Thee, our Redeemer, in the days of the anointed one and none resembles Thee, our Helper, at the revival of the dead.
אֵל אָדוֹן עַל כָּל־הַמַּעֲשִׂים. בָּרוּךְ וּמְבֹרָךְ בְּפִי כָל־נְשָׁמָה: גָּדְלוֹ וְטוּבוֹ מָלֵא עוֹלָם. דַּעַת וּתְבוּנָה סוֹבְבִים אוֹתוֹ:
הַמִּתְגָּאֶה עַל־חַיּוֹת הַקֹּדֶשׁ. וְנֶהְדָּר בְּכָבוֹד עַל־הַמֶּרְכָּבָה:
זְכוּת וּמִישׁוֹר לִפְנֵי כִסְאוֹ. חֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים לִפְנֵי כְבוֹדוֹ:
טוֹבִים מְאוֹרוֹת שֶׁבָּרָא אֱלֹהֵינוּ. יְצָרָם בְּדַעַת בְּבִינָה וּבְהַשְׂכֵּל: כֹּחַ וּגְבוּרָה נָתַן בָּהֶם. לִהְיוֹת מוֹשְׁלִים בְּקֶרֶב תֵּבֵל:
מְלֵאִים זִיו וּמְפִיקִים נֹגַהּ. נָאֶה זִיוָם בְּכָל־הָעוֹלָם. שְׂמֵחִים בְּצֵאתָם וְשָׂשִׂים בְּבוֹאָם. עוֹשִׂים בְּאֵימָה רְצוֹן קוֹנָם:
פְּאֵר וְכָבוֹד נוֹתְנִים לִשְׁמוֹ. צָהֳלָה וְרִנָּה לְזֵכֶר מַלְכוּתוֹ: קָרָא לַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וַיִּזְרַח־אוֹר. רָאָה וְהִתְקִין צוּרַת הַלְּבָנָה:
שֶׁבַח נוֹתְנִים לוֹ כָּל־צְבָא מָרוֹם. תִּפְאֶרֶת וּגְדֻלָּה שְׂרָפִים וְאוֹפַנִּים וְחַיּוֹת הַקֹּדֶשׁ:
God, Lord above all works, blessed and called blessed by the mouth of every soul, His grandeur and His goodness fill the world, knowledge and understanding surround Him.
He who is exalted above the holy Hayoth, splendid in glory above the Merkabah, merit and equity are
before His throne, grace and compassion before His glory.
Good are the lights which our God has created, He has formed them with knowledge, reason and understanding. Power and strength has He placed in them that they may reign in the midst of the world.
They are full of lustre and brightly shine, comely is their lustre over the whole world. They rejoice when they go forth and are jubilant when they come in and fulfil in awe the will of their Owner.
Glory and honour do they give to His Name, joy and delight at the mention of His Kingdom. He called to the sun, then light shone forth, He saw and decreed the shape of the moon.
Praise does the whole host of heaven bestow on Him, fame and grandeur the Seraphim, Ophanim and holy Hayoth.
